findings.title: Removed public symbols from mark_failed may break existing importers/tests
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context` and `SimpleCheckIn` were removed from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` and renamed/moved (e.g. `create_issue_platform_occurrence` -> `incident_occurrence.create_incident_occurrence`). Any other module, task, or test that imports these from the old path (or monkeypatches `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence`) will fail at import time or silently stop being patched. No re-exports or shims are provided, and the PR touches no call sites/tests, so this should be verified across the repo.

findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context ignores the modified config copy
findings.body: The function copies `monitor.config` and rewrites `schedule_type` to its display value, but the returned dict sets `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original), so the human-readable schedule_type is never emitted and the `config` local is dead. Since this code is being moved into a new module, it's a good opportunity to return `config` instead.
